This deletes your account and everything stored in the cloud: your saved designs, the design you are editing and the signing-key backup. Designs and the signing key on this phone stay. Without the passphrase the backup can never be opened, so it will be deleted. Analog Plus makes a new signing key the next time you send a face. Your saved designs are not affected.
The face that is on your watch now was signed with the old key, so the watch refuses updates to it.

To fix that, open Settings on the watch, go to its list of apps (Apps, or Apps & notifications and then App info) and uninstall the Analog Plus watch face. The list may show several entries named Analog Plus: the watch app and the watch faces. The one to uninstall is the watch face; if you are unsure, its details page may show no version number. Then press Send to watch again.
After you send it again, the new face may need to be picked: if it is not shown, press and hold the watch face and choose Analog Plus.

That old face cannot be removed from the watch itself; it needs a computer with adb, the Android debug tool: adb shell pm uninstall com.seyedjafari.analogplus.watchfacepush.analog. Until it is removed, Send to watch will keep failing. If you cannot do that, keep the backup and keep looking for the passphrase.
Without the passphrase the backup can never be opened, so it will be deleted. Your saved designs are not affected.
Delete the backup you cannot open?

The signing key saved on this phone is damaged, so sending a face fails until you use Reset signing key in the Signing key card. Deleting the backup does not do that for you: delete it here first, then use Reset signing key.
If the face on your watch was signed with the backed-up key, the watch will refuse faces signed with this phone\'s key until that face is removed from the watch.

Every face is signed with a key stored in this app. If the app says the key is damaged, or the watch rejects updates after a reinstall or on a new phone, first try Restore signing key from backup in Backup and sync above; make a new key here only if you have no backup.

If you backed up the signing key that signed the face on your watch, restore it with Restore signing key from backup in Backup and sync above instead of making a new one: then nothing has to be removed from the watch.
